div.div:
Security boundaries
1. Internet to gateway: TLS, WAF, JWT validation.
2. Gateway to service: mTLS on a private network, identity forwarded in a signed token.
3. Service to data and to other systems: private endpoints, managed identity, no secrets in code, timeouts on every call.
